**Cranberry Glade** or **Cranberry Glades** is a location in the Cranberry Bog region of Appalachia.

This small glade is one of the few corners of the bog that were spared from the bulldozers and clear cutters of the corporations busy turning the former state park into another piece of urbanized blight. [Pub 1] 

The glade is a large forested stretch of land, bounded on the west by an access road leading to a parking lot with a cooking station. The wooded paths lead through the cranberry-plant covered glade where one can access two collectible spawn points on the eastern side of the forest. Mutated Ferns and gravel dot the landscape, and a Mirelurk Queen will always be found submerged in the water.

Cranberry Glade appears in *Fallout 76*.

Cranberry Glade is based on the real world location of the same name, part of the Monongahela National Forest in the Allegheny Mountains of West Virginia.

Discovering the Cranberry Glade will not register in its listing for the challenge "Discover locales within the Cranberry Bog."
